title: Reach the directory and the sign-in gate from the home page
preconditions: The local app is running and the doctor check passes.

steps.action: Activate the primary CTA 'Browse interview experiences'.
steps.expected: The browser reaches /experiences and the directory heading is visible.

steps.action: Return to / and activate 'Share your experience'.
steps.expected: The browser lands on /login with callbackUrl=/contribute because the contribution form requires sign-in.
